title: Gen1Recomp — Diorama
summary: Jake's fork of Gen1Recomp carrying the ds_luci mod: LUCI head tracking wired into the Dramatic Shape voxel camera, so the game renders as a head-coupled diorama. Pushed to latentJake/gen1recomp on the diorama-luci branch; a PR to bryanthaboi upstream is possible later.
